t: Professional grade bathroom cleaner foam spray. Removes limescale, dirt, stains and rust from taps, shower cubicles, shower heads, bathtubs, sinks, worktops, and toilets to leave a brilliant shine. Apply directly to affected surfaces, leave for a maximum of 5mins, then wipe off and rinse. Suitable for use on chrome, stainless steel, ceramic, glaze, glass and plastic surfaces.
